Tales from the Crypt1992

1992 series · King of the Road · directed by Tom Holland

Does Brad Pitt die in Tales from the Crypt?

He plays Billy Drake.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

Yes. Loses the drag race to the Iceman and goes up in a fireball.

Cocky psycho drag racer Billy rolls into town to goad Sheriff Joe Garrett, secretly the legendary racer 'Iceman', into one last race. When Joe refuses, Billy seduces and then kidnaps his daughter Carey to force him behind the wheel. In the midnight race Billy slams into a digger parked in the road and dies in a fireball while Joe wins.

Season 4 episode "King of the Road", directed by Tom Holland. Also released as a segment of the compilation TV film Two-Fisted Tales (1992).
